cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit It Wasn’t Fair
cards.instruction: Get an apology that acknowledges how the rules, comparison, or outcome worked against you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Could you apologise for judging my cake after everyone knew it was mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. You introduced it as 'another interesting attempt.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then apologise for encouraging the judges before they'd tasted it.
